title: AI transformation and the enterprise value gap
purpose: Test whether a local model can synthesize five source-separated evidence cards and three personal thoughts into an accurate, useful German LinkedIn post.

output.audience: Executives, knowledge workers and technically interested professional readers
output.format: One evidence-grounded LinkedIn post with short paragraphs

strengths: Directly represents the user's source-grounded professional-writing workflow
Requires synthesis across five sources and multiple levels of analysis
Separates empirical evidence from user-authored perspective
Combines factual grounding, argument construction, selection and audience-aware writing
limitations: English evidence and German output combine synthesis with cross-lingual writing
The project selects and paraphrases evidence before candidate generation, so this case does not evaluate online research or source selection
LinkedIn suitability remains partly subjective and therefore requires a rubric-grounded judge
One post cannot establish a stable distribution of writing quality
